row: Hello everyone. My name is Mykhailo Ozmenchuk or Dr Micha. I am veterinarian from Ukraine, currently live and work in Las Vegas. On this channel I share with you my professional and private life.  You will find useful information about the veterinary life in the USA, how to become a veterinarian in the USA for foreign graduate, etc. We will study, explore and grew together. Excited to meet you guys.
